entries.title: Hebrews 3:1
segments: ¶Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of [the] heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:2
segments: who is faithful to him that has constituted him, as Moses also in all his house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:3
segments: For *he* has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, by how much he that has built it has more honour than the house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:4
segments: For every house is built by some one; but he who has built all things [is] God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:5
segments: And Moses indeed [was] faithful in all his house, as a ministering servant, for a testimony of the things to be spoken after;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:6
segments: but Christ, as Son over his house, whose house are *we*, if indeed we hold fast the boldness and the boast of hope firm to the end.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:7
segments: ¶Wherefore, even as says the Holy Spirit, To-day if ye will hear his voice,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:8
segments: harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:9
segments: where your fathers tempted [me], by proving [me], and saw my works forty years.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:10
segments: Wherefore I was wroth with this generation, and said, They always err in heart; and *they* have not known my ways;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:11
segments: so I swore in my wrath, If they shall enter into my rest.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:12
segments: See, brethren, lest there be in any one of you a wicked heart of unbelief, in turning away from [the] living God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:13
segments: But encourage yourselves each day, as long as it is called To-day, that none of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:14
segments: For we are become companions of the Christ if indeed we hold the beginning of the assurance firm to the end;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:15
segments: in that it is said, To-day if ye will hear his voice, do not harden your hearts, as in the provocation;

entries.title: Hebrews 3:16
segments: (for who was it, who, having heard, provoked? but [was it] not all who came out of Egypt by Moses?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:17
segments: And with whom was he wroth forty years? [Was it] not with those who had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:18
segments: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to those who had not hearkened to the word?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:19
segments: And we see that they could not enter in on account of unbelief;)
